name: Herdr
summary: Release builds send a daily report with a random install ID to telemetry.herdr.dev. It contains app and core versions, OS and architecture, bucketed usage time and counts, agent names, built-in layout names, mod counts, command names and event counters. It never includes terminal content, file or folder paths, or custom names.

optOut.instructions: Open Settings → Privacy in Herdr and turn telemetry off, or set "telemetry": false in settings.json. For a single run, launch with DO_NOT_TRACK=1 or HERDR_TELEMETRY=0. Update checks continue.
